Several turns covered when the user takes metformin, the dose, and whether it is XR.
The bot suggested a 3am reading and the user asked how it works and what follows.
The bot raised second agents and basal insulin; the user only reacted to the insulin mention.
The user said 'same thing you say, go to doctor' and wanted non-doctor steps, but only briefly.

output.summary: The user asked why their fasting sugar is always 160-180 despite taking metformin at night, walking daily and eating less rice. The user ended with 'I understand' and 'ok thanks', without clearly saying their need was met.
